posts.title: One Black Dog
posts.description: Starting in September, I unwittingly entered the Doldrums. I'm not even sure when it started, though my therapist thinks it's linked to when Atom started high school. Maybe. posts.description: The Kid returns today from a week away at camp. Lots of mixed feelings about this.
